title: Phase 0: golden contract vector corpus
objective: Materialize every §44 golden vector as committed data under the testdata/contracts/ concern directories required by §45, with each vector recording stub/config preconditions, request, expected status, and expected body.
nonGoals: no executable assertions yet, only vector data
nextAction: Start FJ-004 (CI: tests, race, vet, build matrix, offline).
notes: Class is product (testdata/**), so all five stages were required and go test/vet/build ran. No Go code was added; those checks confirm the corpus did not break the build.

23 vector files: all 16 C-GOLD-001..016 plus 7 derived vectors in a separate VEC-* namespace. Derived vectors are traceable to normative MUSTs outside §44 (§13.4, §13.5, §40.3, §39.2, §39.3, §43.4, §22.3) because §45 requires a mixed/ directory that §44 has no vector for. Rejecting them is a scope decision, not a correctness fix.
No vector was executed. This item delivers data only; FJ-046 owns the runner. Everything verified here is structural, plus cross-artifact agreement against the FJ-002 schema and OpenAPI enumerations.

The corpus deliberately does not assert journal timestamps (§8.6, §41.7) and does not assert /verify failure message text, which §41.9 does not freeze. Data-plane failure bodies ARE asserted exactly because §43.1-43.7 fix those strings. A runner must treat the literal string <not asserted> as a skip, declared in the conventions block of every file.
